2026_01_WAS_PHI.headline: Philadelphia’s option stress can matter more than Washington’s cleaner injury sheet
2026_01_WAS_PHI.paragraph1: Washington finished Friday with no final game designations, while the Eagles ruled Jonathan Greenard out and list Eli Stowers as questionable. The Commanders own the cleaner availability picture, but Philadelphia can still dictate the tactical problem with quarterback run-pass conflicts and a physical offensive front. Washington needs disciplined edges and interior gap control so the Eagles cannot make every defender wrong after the snap; Philadelphia can use formation and tempo to expose any hesitation created by those assignments.
2026_01_WAS_PHI.model_rationale: Philadelphia’s offense can manufacture assignment conflicts even against a healthy defense, and its ability to change the read after the snap creates the decisive pressure.
